title: 第3829章 天仙境大敌第3828章 牛家村养伤马匪
lines: 推荐各位书友阅读：吞噬九重天第3829章天仙境大敌（..la）“果真是他！”
周武看着飞剑消失的方向，低声说道。
“父亲，我们得救了，是谁，是谁救了我们？”
周元看着死伤一地的马匪，兴奋地笑脸通红，又蹦又跳。
牛家村的一众村民也是从惊喜中迅速反应了过来。
他们本以为这次在劫难逃了，没想到，在关键时刻，竟然剑仙出手，一剑斩杀了所有马匪。
“父亲，我刚才看见剑光了，出手之人是剑仙，一定是剑仙！
周元满脸崇拜之色。
他自幼的梦想便是成为一名可以御剑飞行，剑斩妖魔的剑仙。
周武收回目光，看向面前又蹦又跳，满脸崇拜之色的周元，神色极为复杂，他原本执意阻拦周元习武，为的就是不让周元进入残酷的武道世界之中，希望周元能够以普通人的身份，平平安安的度过一生，可此刻，他的这个想法动摇了。
仙界，本就是个极为残酷的世界，弱者想要平稳生活，无病无灾，简直就是个奢望，比如今日，若是没人出手，牛家村的所有人将会无一幸存……
周武心中默默下定了决心。
“元儿，走，陪我去见一下我们牛家村的恩人。”
周元听到这话，眼睛一亮，惊喜道：“父亲，你知道那位剑仙是谁？”
“你也认识他！”
周武说道。
“我也认识？”
周元一愣，想了想，道：“难道是村东头的瘸腿老头？他一直吹嘘自己是个剑仙，难道真的是他？”
“到了你就知晓了。”
周武带着周元向村子走去，而其他牛家村的人，则开始搬运血刀马匪的尸体，以及救治被马匪砍伤的村民。
“父亲，这不是我们家吗？怎么……”
周元看着周武在自家小院前停下，满脸疑惑的说道。
周武没有回答周元这个问题，伸手推开小院院门，只见一袭青衫的许辰，坐在石墩上，正在静静地品茶。
许辰放下茶杯，抬头看向走入小院的周武，道：“来啦，坐吧！”
许辰仿佛一副他才是这座小院的主人一般，伸手示意周武在对面坐下。
周武也没客气，在许辰对面的石墩上坐下。
许辰给周武倒了一杯茶，道：“我这人不懂茶，只觉得此茶好喝，你也尝一尝。”
周武看着许辰递过来的茶水，迟疑了一下，接过茶水，轻抿了一口，茶水带着一股特殊的茶香。
许辰不懂茶，但周武显然是懂得，茶水入口的那一瞬，他便是眼睛一亮，道：“好茶！”
他喝了这么多年茶，还是头一次喝到如此醇厚的茶水。
许辰笑而不语的看着周武。
就在周武将口中之茶咽肚之后，双眸陡然瞪大，他仔细感受了一下，然后整个人便是激动的浑身发抖，“许，许辰道友，这，这是什么茶水？”
“具体什么茶，我也不太清楚，不过，看样子，此话应该对你的伤势不错。”
许辰笑着说道。
周武将杯中茶水一饮而尽。
数息后。
原本病态般的苍白脸色，竟是恢复了一丝红润，整个人的气色看起来也好了不少。
一杯茶，虽然无法令他的伤势彻底痊愈，但至少让他的状态好了不少，体内的妖毒也解了一些。
周武长长呼出一口气，整个人感觉前所未有的轻松，这么多年以来，他还是第一次感觉如此轻松。

Recommended reading for all book lovers: Devouring the Nine Heavens Chapter 3829: Enemy in the Heavenly Immortal Realm (..la) "It's really him!"
Zhou Wu looked at the direction in which Feijian disappeared and whispered.
"Father, we are saved, who, who saved us?"
Zhou Yuan looked at the horse bandits who were dead and injured, smiling with excitement and jumping up and down.
All the villagers in Niujia Village also reacted quickly from the surprise.
They thought they were doomed this time, but unexpectedly, at the critical moment, the sword fairy took action and killed all the horse bandits with one sword.
"Father, I saw the sword light just now. The person who made the move was a sword fairy. He must be a sword fairy!
! "
Zhou Yuan's face was full of admiration.
His dream since childhood was to become a swordsman who could fly with a sword and kill demons with his sword.
Zhou Wu withdrew his gaze and looked at Zhou Yuan, who was jumping up and down in front of him with a look of admiration on his face, with a very complicated expression. He originally insisted on stopping Zhou Yuan from practicing martial arts in order to prevent Zhou Yuan from entering the cruel world of martial arts. He hoped that Zhou Yuan could live a peaceful life as an ordinary person, but at this moment, his idea was shaken.
The fairy world is an extremely cruel world. It is simply a luxury hope for the weak to live a stable life without illness or disaster. For example, today, if no one takes action, no one in Niujia Village will survive...
Zhou Wu silently made up his mind.
"Yuan'er, let's go and accompany me to meet our benefactor in Niujia Village."
When Zhou Yuan heard this, his eyes lit up and he said in surprise: "Father, do you know who the Sword Immortal is?"
"You know him too!"
Zhou Wu said.
"I know him too?"
Zhou Yuan was stunned, thought for a while, and said: "Is it the lame old man at the east end of the village? He has always boasted that he is a swordsman, is it really him?"
"You'll know when you get there."
Zhou Wu led Zhou Yuan towards the village, while other people from Niujia Village began to carry the bodies of the bloody knife horse bandits and treat the villagers who were chopped by the horse bandits.
…
"Father, isn't this our home? Why..."
Zhou Yuan watched Zhou Wu stop in front of his small courtyard and said with confusion on his face.
Zhou Wu did not answer Zhou Yuan's question, and stretched out his hand to open the door of the small courtyard. He saw Xu Chen, dressed in a green shirt, sitting on the stone pier, quietly sipping tea.
Xu Chen put down his tea cup, looked up at Zhou Wu who walked into the courtyard, and said, "Here you go, sit down!"
As if he was the master of this small courtyard, Xu Chen stretched out his hand and motioned for Zhou Wu to sit down opposite.
Zhou Wu was not polite and sat down on the stone pier opposite Xu Chen.
Xu Chen poured a cup of tea for Zhou Wu and said, "I don't understand tea. I just think this tea is delicious. You should try it too."
Zhou Wu looked at the tea handed over by Xu Chen, hesitated for a moment, took the tea, and took a sip. The tea had a special tea aroma.
Xu Chen didn't understand tea, but Zhou Wu obviously did. The moment the tea came into his mouth, his eyes lit up and he said, "Good tea!"
After drinking tea for so many years, this was the first time he drank such mellow tea.
Xu Chen looked at Zhou Wu with a smile without saying a word.
Just after General Zhou swallowed the tea in his mouth, his eyes suddenly widened. He felt it carefully, and then his whole body trembled with excitement, "Xu, Taoist friend Xu Chen, what kind of tea is this?"
"I don't know exactly what kind of tea it is, but it seems like this should be good for your injury."
Xu Chen said with a smile.
General Zhou drank all the tea in his cup.
After counting the interest.
His originally sickly pale complexion actually regained a trace of rosiness, and his overall complexion looked much better.
Although a cup of tea could not completely heal his injuries, it at least made his condition much better and relieved some of the demonic poison in his body.
Zhou Wu exhaled a long breath, feeling more relaxed than ever before. This was the first time in so many years that he felt so relaxed.
